scientific_integrity: The proof is a direct quantifier-and-norm argument. It uses the source normalization and the admissible universal choice \(b=2\), \(\varepsilon=1\); no computational experiment or unproved auxiliary claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The finding concerns only the literal finite-dimensional Banach Weaver formulations numbered 2.21--2.28 in arXiv:2201.00125v1. It does not solve a repaired formulation with a fixed or uniformly bounded number of blocks.
title: Singleton partitions settle the eight stated Banach Weaver conjectures
